entries.source: Lorenz Fries, Hohe Registratur, entry 3625, Standbuch 1011
entries.summary: Der Nachtrag berichtet, dass die Angelegenheit durch Ritter Albrecht von Rosenberg zu Neuenstein am 28. Oktober 1563 beigelegt wurde.
entries.german: Nachtragshand: Sendt aber die [unleserlich] durch heren Albrechten von Rosenberg Ritteren zu [unleserlich] tractation komen vnd vermogen [unleserlich] zu Newenstein an Simon vnd Jude anno 1563 Recepta in 10 Contractuum friderici fol 106
entries.english: Later marginal addition: The [illegible] were, however, negotiated through Albrecht von Rosenberg, Ritter, at [illegible], and [illegible] at Neuenstein on the Feast of Saints Simon and Jude in 1563, recorded in the tenth register of Friedrich’s contracts, fol. 106.

facts.content: mediated the settlement at Neuenstein concerning the purchase of Bickenbach.
